title: 1965 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Snake
seo_title: 1965 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Snake (2 February – 20 January 1966)
description: 1965 is the Year of the Wood Snake (Yin, Yi-si), from 2 February 1965 to 20 January 1966. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1965.
lead: Born in 1965? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Snake, but check the date: the 1965 Wood Snake year began on 2 February 1965. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1965: Year of the Wood Snake, from 2 February 1965 to 20 January 1966.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1965 was the Year of the Snake. It began with Lunar New Year on 2 February 1965 and ended on 20 January 1966, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1965 ends in 5, which makes it a Wood year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1965 is a Yi-si year. The same Wood Snake combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1905 before it and 2025 after it.
Lunar New Year 1965 fell on 2 February 1965, so everyone born in January 1965, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Dragon.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Snake guide describes the sign like this: “Wise, intuitive, and elegant. Snakes are deep thinkers who plan carefully before acting.” The usual watch-out: “Can be secretive or prone to overthinking.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Snake page.
Careers often linked with the Snake: finance, research, psychology, strategy.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1965
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Snake's best matches are the Ox, Rooster and Monkey, and its clash sign is the Pig, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Snake years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1953 (Water Snake); 1977 (Fire Snake); 1989 (Earth Snake). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1965 is the Year of the Snake, a Yin Wood Snake year (Yi-si).
When does the 1965 Year of the Snake start and end?
It starts on 2 February 1965 and ends on 20 January 1966.
I was born in January 1965. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Dragon: Lunar New Year 1965 was on 2 February 1965, so all of January 1965 belongs to the Dragon year.
Wood. 1965 ends in 5, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Snake compatible with?
Traditionally the Ox, Rooster and Monkey. The Snake's clash sign is the Pig.
